snippet.title: Sumorbit: Sumo Wrestling Planets Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1653190/Sumorbit/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/sumorbit/9PDQVGFX33W8/

A physics based fighting game where planets sumo wrestle. Grab with your moon and bounce with your planet to launch opponents out of the solar system. 1-8 player sumo battles & single player campaign.

Website: https://sumorbit.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Sumorbit
Discord: https://discord.gg/Mc78SG86dC
Music by https://oscarjemmott.com
